photo.caption: The "Pyramid of Capitalist System" cartoon made by the Industrial Workers of the World (1911) is an example of a socialist critique of capitalism and of social stratification.
photo.description: A 1911 Industrial Worker (IWW newspaper) publication advocating industrial unionism that shows the critique of capitalism. It is based on a flyer of the "Union of Russian Socialists" spread in 1900 and 1901 (the File:Capitalist pyramid 1900.png)

provenance.credit: Artist not credited. Published by International Pub. Co., Cleveland, Ohio.
